    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Brew
    Contains the processing rules for recipe-mode and creative-mode brewing.
    BrewPanel
    allows the player to select either recipe mode or creative brewing mode
    ConcoctionBase
     
    Controller
    transfers information between model and gui controller manages current player, saving, brewing, transactions, bonuses, and counters
    CreativePanel
    Allows the player to select one concoction base and one to three unique fruits for an experimental brew.
    Fruit
     
    Ingredient
    Represents one fruit ingredient or concoction base available in the game.
    Inventory
    Stores the player's ingredient quantities and aggregate cauldron counts.
    InventoryPanel
    Displays the player's ingredient quantities and usable and unusable cauldron counts.
    ItemCard
    Visual card representing one ingredient stack in the inventory or creative brewing interface
    ItemStack
    Stores an ingredient together with the quantity owned by the player.
    Listing
    Represents one of the eight market slots.
    Main
    Main for running the actual program
    MainFrame
    main application window.
    MainMenuPanel
    Displays the primary game menu, current player information, and buttons for accessing everything in the game
    Market
    Manages market generation, buying, and selling.
    MarketItemCard
    Visual card representing one ingredient or cauldron listing in the market.
    MarketPanel
    Displays the market's buying and selling interfaces and manages the user's temporary market selections.
    Player
    Stores the player's persistent game data.
    Recipe
    Represents one predefined concoction from the Potion Compendium.
    RecipeBook
    Stores the complete Potion Compendium and the recipe IDs unlocked by the player.
    RecipeCard
    Expandable visual card representing a recipe and whether the player owns its required ingredients.
    RecipePanel
    displays unlocked recipes that may be selected and brewed using the player's current inventory
    Save
    Reads and writes player data using the required plain-text save format.
    SellItemCard
    Visual card used to select how many units of an ingredient will be sold.
    SpellbookPanel
    displays all recipes that the current player has unlocked
    StartPanel
    starting screen used to create a new game or load an existing player save
    Theme
    Defines the application's shared colors and applies consistent styling to Swing components.
